meta.title: Award dialog allows modifying the quantity to award

steps.note: Open the prepared bid comparison for an event with at least two vendor bids.
Enter the awarding screen where vendor selections and award quantities can be changed.

args.goal: On the awarding screen, select a vendor under a line item, modify the quantity to award to a partial quantity of the requested line quantity, click Award, and stop only when the vendor's awarded quantity and the Proposal value visibly reflect exactly the modified quantity.

steps.note: Perform and verify the quantity modification and its effect on the award and proposal value, which no dedicated catalog step can model.
Confirm the awarding screen remains at the proposal-creation stage after the partial award.
